summary: Examples test /etc/hosts with link_exists and select paths whose links exist.
questions: How do I select paths that exist without following symlinks?

answer_card.title: link_exists test examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
ismyhostsalink: "{{ '/etc/hosts' is link_exists }}"
list_of_symlinks: "{{ list_of_paths | select('link_exists') }}"
```
